title: Spec
description: An unambiguous, testable specification. Every claim is verifiable or explicitly marked as a judgment call.

purpose.description: One paragraph: what this spec defines and why it exists

scope.description: What is covered by this spec

criterion.description: A testable proposition — something that can be confirmed true or false

is_error_case.description: True if this criterion describes behavior under an error condition

judgment_call.description: True if this criterion requires human judgment to evaluate. Must include rationale.

linked_requirement.description: ID of the requirement@1 this spec implements

linked_research.description: ID of the research-report@1 that informed this spec

spec_file_path.description: Workspace-relative path where this spec is written on disk (e.g. .claude/specs/SPEC-001.json). Set by the canon skill orchestrator after gate passes. Agents resolve it against workspace_root from the recon manifest.

revision_note.description: Set when this spec is a correction of a previously gated spec, typically sourced from a implementer spec_contradiction report. Describes what changed and why, citing the affected criterion_id. Absent on first drafts.
